reasoning: Alabama remains overwhelmingly Republican in current published polling and election coverage. The most relevant recent Senate poll shows Republican Barry Moore ahead of Democrat Everett Wess by 15 points, and Cook’s 2026 PVI update indicates Alabama is R+28 statewide, reinforcing the structural GOP advantage.
